verdict.rationale: dlt provides a first-party dbt runner that is invoked from within the same Python pipeline script immediately after `pipeline.run()`, so dbt models execute right after fresh data lands rather than on a separate schedule; dltHub also auto-generates dbt staging/fact models from the just-loaded pipeline schema, reinforcing load-then-transform sequencing. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the dbt runner reliably triggers post-load in production (only vendor docs cited).
